description:
The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/penguins.csv' is already open in JASP. This is the Palmer Penguins dataset from the Palmer Station Long Term Ecological Research program in Antarctica. It contains morphometric measurements for 334 penguins across three species (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) from three islands. The columns include: species, island, bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g, sex, and year.

Perform a comprehensive exploratory data analysis spanning three JASP modules and save the results as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/penguins_eda.jasp'.

1. Descriptive Statistics: Open the Descriptives module and run Descriptive Statistics. Add the four morphometric variables (bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g) to the Variables box, and add 'species' to the Split box. Under Statistics, enable Mean, Std. deviation, Median, Minimum, and Maximum. Under Plots, enable Distribution plots (histograms).

2. Correlation Analysis: Open the Regression module and select Correlation. Add the same four morphometric variables to the Variables box. Under Options, enable 'Report significance' and 'Flag significant correlations'. Under Plots, enable the Heatmap.

3. One-Way ANOVA: Open the ANOVA module and select ANOVA. Set 'body_mass_g' as the Dependent Variable and 'species' as the Fixed Factor. Under Post Hoc Tests, move 'species' to the active list and ensure Tukey is selected. Under Additional Options, enable 'Descriptive statistics'.

After configuring all three analyses, save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/penguins_eda.jasp' using File > Save As.
